doc: Reviewed classification of non-REST entry types in apps/*. tests/test_entrypoint_inventory.py fails when an entry type appears or disappears without a matching entry here.

entries.name: _parent.mount
entries.rationale: Composes the apps' own ASGI apps under one server; each mounted app carries its own route policies (route_authz) and operator boundary. The mount adds no route of its own.

entries.name: threading.Thread
entries.rationale: Outcome observer, off unless BILLING_OUTCOME_INTERVAL_S > 0. Its tick only observes due outcomes (a read from Lago plus recording learning); it takes the loop lock non-blocking and never refits or executes. No external write.

entries.name: _shutdown
entries.rationale: Router startup/shutdown: rehydrates parked missions and starts/stops the optional observer above. No request-reachable effect.

entries.name: _startup
entries.rationale: Router startup/shutdown: rehydrates parked missions and starts/stops the optional observer above. No request-reachable effect.

entries.name: threading.Thread
entries.rationale: Detached job started by the public /api/chat route to run an in-app content-generation action chosen by the chat model. It passes no approval marker, so the core stages any consequential action (push_assets); the result lands in an in-memory job table.
